# Summer Inspection & Logistique W/A LTD (SILWA)
> Official Website: https://summerinspectlog.com/
> Primary Email: biz@summerinspectlog.com
> Emergency / Operations Hotline: +234 7045515750
> Incorporation: 2010
> Primary Location: Lagos, Nigeria (Serving All West African Ports & Offshore Terminals)

## Overview & Corporate Identity
Summer Inspection & Logistique West Africa (SILWA) Limited is a premier maritime inspection, cargo superintendence, and marine logistics company incorporated in 2010. The company provides independent, certified, and expeditious survey services for vessel owners, charterers, oil and gas operators, financial institutions, and insurance underwriters operating across West Africa and the Gulf of Guinea.

## Core Capabilities & Services

1. **Pre-Charter Vessel Inspection & Certification**:
   Comprehensive seaworthiness, hull, machinery, and equipment inspections to mitigate cargo loss, delays, and demurrage risks.

2. **Cargo Surveying, Inspection & Superintendence**:
   Draft surveys, bunker surveys (ROB/BOD), on-hire/off-hire surveys, damage assessment, quality and quantity assurance for dry bulk, liquid cargo, and containerized freight.

3. **Inventory Management & Sales Monitoring**:
   Custody transfer monitoring, tank farm management, depot stock audits, and daily inventory control to avert fraudulent practices and product loss.

4. **Certification of Maritime Equipment**:
   Testing and certification of Ship-to-Ship (STS) transfer equipment, including marine fenders, transfer hoses, pumps, life-saving appliances, and offshore equipment.

5. **Loss Control & Investigation**:
   Rigorous loss control mechanisms during loading, voyage, and discharge operations to reduce transit variances.

6. **Wet Cargo Blending**:
   Specialized blending of off-spec petroleum and chemical liquid cargoes to meet international market and client specifications.

7. **Agricultural & Allied Products Inspection**:
   Quality certification, grading, sampling, and moisture analysis for export/import agricultural commodities (cocoa, cashew nuts, sesame, grains).

8. **Insurance Claim Handling & Claim Justification**:
   Technical evidence gathering, surveyor reports, and expert marine claim justification for P&I Clubs, hull underwriters, and cargo adjusters.

9. **Training & Retraining of Personnel**:
   Certified operational training modules for marine surveyors, SIWES industrial attachment students, and NYSC corps members.

10. **Engineering & Maritime Calculators**:
    Theoretical Density Calculator for ASTM petroleum measurements (API gravity to Specific Gravity 60°F and density at 15°C), Air Freight Pallet specs (LD3, LD7, PMC), and standard Shipping Container specifications.
